license_list.description: optional. If provided, only inserts whose license_no is in this list are returned.

limit.description:
max entries in `updates` (default 200, newest-first). `total`/`by_date` still
reflect every update; `truncated` is true when the list was capped. A wide date
range can match thousands of inserts — keep this bounded or narrow `since_date`.
Pass 0 or a negative value to disable the cap.

since_date.description:
'YYYY-MM-DD' — lower bound (inclusive), a Taiwan date. The range runs to
today's Taiwan date and may span at most 31 days; a wider range returns error
`DATE_RANGE_TOO_WIDE`, and a future date returns `INVALID_DATE`. Each day is one
FDA request (about 0.5 s if empty, 20-120 s on a weekday), so prefer a recent date.
